listingSettingsGroup.title: Listing Settings Groups
listingSettingsGroup.subtitle: Manage and assign strategy templates to your product listings for automated optimization.
listingSettingsGroup.stripBrandFromTitleHint: Strip the Amazon brand name from eBay titles when creating listings (dropshipping-friendly).
listingSettingsGroup.aiTitleEnabledHint: New listings only. Requires "llm.contentEnabled" to be on at Admin → Settings. A failure or timeout falls back to the normal title, so listing creation never blocks.
listingSettingsGroup.aiDescriptionEnabledHint: New listings only. Requires "llm.contentEnabled" to be on at Admin → Settings. Falls back to your template/features on failure. Existing listings are never reprocessed.
listingSettingsGroup.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this group?
listingSettingsGroup.confirmDeleteMessage: This action cannot be undone. Products using this group will need to be reassigned.

emptyState.title: No Listing Groups Yet
emptyState.description: Create your first group to start organizing your listings

predefinedTemplates.modernMinimalistDesc: Clean and professional design with focus on product details

validation.nameMinLength: Group name must be at least 3 characters
validation.nameMaxLength: Group name must not exceed 100 characters
validation.minPrice: Minimum price must be greater than 0
validation.maxPrice: Maximum price must be greater than 0
validation.maxPriceGreaterThanMin: Maximum price must be greater than minimum price
validation.profitRequired: Either profit margin or fixed profit is required
validation.profitMarginRange: Profit margin must be between 0 and 100
validation.fixedProfitMin: Fixed profit must be 0 or greater
validation.minFeePercent: Fee percentage must be 0 or greater
validation.minFixedFee: Fixed fee must be 0 or greater
validation.minTaxPercent: Tax percentage must be 0 or greater
validation.templateMinLength: Template must be at least 10 characters
validation.minOnePriceRange: At least one price range is required
validation.minStockBuffer: Stock buffer must be 0 or greater

errors.unauthorized: You don't have permission to perform this action
errors.networkError: Network error. Please check your connection.

help.repricingStrategy: Define multiple price ranges with different profit margins. Products will be priced according to their cost range.
help.profitMargin: Percentage-based profit calculated from the product cost.
help.fixedProfit: Fixed dollar amount added to the product cost.
help.tax: Sales tax percentage for your location.
help.customTemplate: Write your own HTML template with custom styling.

listingSettingsGroup.editorDescription: Configure your listing settings, pricing strategies, and templates.
listingSettingsGroup.stockBufferDescription: Minimum Amazon stock to keep as buffer. Listing goes out of stock when Amazon stock drops to or below (quantity + buffer)
